title: Distinguish executed selected-record CLI failures from unavailable control on recovery results
outcome: An exact-record CLI process failure reports the same truthful executed-read failure class as other recovery reads.
acceptance: For a non-envelope selected-record CLI failure, the recovery result retains actual exit and byte observations and identifies cli_read_failed rather than implying unavailable control; genuine selected-reference refusal and crash/prose classification remain unchanged.
Behavioral recovery coverage exercises the exact-record phase through the production raw CLI boundary and checks returned, retained and parent-visible classification without exposing producer detail.
